intro: After Doling Justice, Kindal Moonweaver greets you on your return from Darnassus with news: a nest full of eggs was saved, though the mother died. Kindal offers you one of the eggs as a pet and sends you on to Quentin, who waits by the race tracks in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Don't let my location fool you, I'm really not here for the races... As entertaining as they may be.

I'm actually here in Thousand Needles investigating all I can to find out how salvageable the land is. It has become my crusade of sorts to revitalize and replenish the area with new, fertile soil. Perhaps I'll find there's a water source nearby.
Tell me you haven't noticed how odd the transition between Feralas and Thousand Needles is. Strange magic was afoot when that happened.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, a sprite darter egg, and one near maturation, if I'm not mistaken. Remarkable you've found one, let alone in this good a condition. They're rarely seen in Feralas these days. I understand there were various poachers in the area trying to capture and kill them for many reasons. Too bad really... Such beautiful creatures when they reach adulthood.
How did you come across such a find?
